claims.text: Notices must be in writing and may be sent by mail, telefax, courier, or otherwise delivered to the party's listed address, or to a different address substituted by written notice.

citations.quote: All notices given under the Agreement are to be in writing and may be sent by mail, telefax, courier service or otherwise delivered to the party to be notified at the following address, or to such other address as may have been substituted by written notice:

claims.text: Notices to Distributor (Ingram Micro) go to the Santa Ana, California address in the notice block. The street line is the placeholder [ADDRESS_3] with [ADDRESS_4] also shown, so the full street address is not legible in the source.

Notices to NETGEAR go to the Santa Clara, California address in the notice block, with the addressee shown as the placeholder [PERSON_1]. The street lines appear as the placeholders [ADDRESS_2] and [ADDRESS_5].

The notice block is garbled in the source. The mapping of the placeholders to each party's street lines is not fully clear, and a "(???)" mark appears in the block, so the exact notice addresses should be confirmed against the executed agreement.
